about_the_game:
Build shelter, gather resources, and rescue fellow survivors to establish a foothold in the hostile wilderness. Each survivor you rescue brings their own personality, skills, and needs to the colony - house them in custom-built bedrooms, assign them to workshops, or send them on expeditions to gather resources.

Progress from primitive tools through medieval technology and beyond into the age of industrial steam power. Manage your growing colony as you defend against jungle threats and uncover the secrets of the wilderness. 

Features:

- Complex NPC colonists with unique traits and relationships

- Dynamic base building and room detection

- Tech progression from primitive survival to steampunk industry and beyond

- Workshop system for processing and crafting materials

- Rich expedition system for resource gathering and rescue missions

- Dynamic day/night cycle and weather cycle

- Farming, Cooking, Relationships!
